notes: FAIL vs BLOCKED: no gate FAILED (no record is wrong, no leak exists, no test failed). Every open gate is BLOCKED: it waits on an owner action (signature, decision, or implementation) that has not happened. BLOCKED is not a softer PASS; it bars release exactly as a FAIL would, but its fix is an owner action, not a content correction.
